status_message: Independent scan completed: 16 candidates reviewed; 0 qualified, 2 watch, 11 economic rejections, 1 portfolio-concentration rejection, and 2 evidence-blocked.
portfolio_note: Independent scan: 16 candidates (8 tokens, 8 natural-resource equities). No execution-ready idea. AAVE and AKT remain conditional WATCH candidates; WATCH is research pending, not a buy signal.

evidence.methodology: Screened eight tokens and eight natural-resource equities against all live personal/RRSP, Evolution/TFSA, Kraken and Alpaca exposures, published-history exclusions, adjacent structured quote bars, capitalization/supply, value capture, dilution, 3–12 month catalysts, permanent-loss risk and executable liquidity. Economic rejection, concentration, evidence-blocked and WATCH outcomes are kept distinct.

sources.note: Structured token price, market capitalization, fully diluted valuation, supply, volume and one-year change for eight candidates.
Structured adjacent daily bars and one-year series; seven additional equity symbols were checked through the same endpoint.
Aave DAO buyback, revenue, emissions and treasury-runway evidence dated February 28, 2026.
Official BME launch, compute-spend and product-usage evidence dated April 1, 2026.
Official network spend, fees, deployments and 2026 migration catalyst evidence dated January 9, 2026.

ideas.name: Akash Network
ideas.snapshot: US$0.5817 at 2026-09-21 00:00 UTC; US$172.3m market cap / US$172.3m FDV; -49.3% over one year; US$4.6m reported 24h volume.
ideas.thesis: Akash reports BME live since March 23, linking compute payments to market purchases and burns of AKT, alongside US$5m cumulative compute spend and a planned network migration by December 30, 2026.
ideas.risk: Not execution-ready: current net AKT burn, current fee-dollar run-rate, post-BME recurring demand, unlock/inflation schedule and venue-specific slippage at intended size were not all independently verified. BME can be inflationary when settlement economics move against the burn.
ideas.trigger: Upgrade only after three consecutive months of primary-source net burn and compute-spend growth, a complete current emissions/unlock schedule, and executable slippage below 1% at the intended starter size; require the migration milestone to remain dated and funded.
